name: C0* product document package
source: Extracted from the 01.ROCKBOX shipped-product structure; generic (exemplar only, no client content).
numbering_note: RockBox numbers PRD as C07; the genesis-first variant uses C00. Both map to key 'prd'.
contract: Every section declares the four capabilities so the MCP+skills know, per layer, WHAT to fill, HOW to elicit it, WHICH tool generates it, and WHICH tool verifies it. `coverage` flags status: full | partial | gap.

roles.constraints: bodesign supplies constraints only; the deliverable is produced downstream.
roles.track+interface: owned by another team; bodesign records interface constraints + keeps them in sync.
roles.draft+guide: bodesign drafts a plan + readiness guide; actual execution is outsourced.

sections.title: PRD — 產品需求文件
verify_with: consistency vs C03 design intent — TODO

coverage.note: Elicitation works (14-item bank). No structured PRD document emitter; no PRD completeness/consistency verifier.

question_bank.label: Compute (MCU/SoC/NPU)
question_bank.question: Which exact MCU/SoC part and package? (e.g. STM32N657 VFBGA223)

question_bank.label: Connectivity
question_bank.question: Which connectivity standard(s) and exact module? (cellular / Wi-Fi / BLE / Ethernet)

question_bank.label: Memory / storage
question_bank.question: Flash/RAM type, density, and interface? (e.g. 8 GB eMMC vs octal-SPI NOR)

question_bank.label: Power input
question_bank.question: Power input connector and voltage range? (USB-C PD profile? DC input?)

question_bank.label: Charging
question_bank.question: Charging current and charger IC preference? cell chemistry to charge?

question_bank.label: Battery
question_bank.question: Battery: cell count/config, capacity, and protection/fuel-gauge needs?

question_bank.label: Form factor / dimensions
question_bank.question: Target board dimensions / form-factor or enclosure constraints?

question_bank.label: Compliance targets
question_bank.question: Any compliance targets? (FCC / CE / EMC / safety)

question_bank.label: Build volume
question_bank.question: Prototype or production volume? (affects sourcing and DFM)

sections.engine: plan-builder (lifecycle / scaffold / sync / readiness) — BUT the output file structure conforms to the RockBox PRD template, NOT plan-builder's default proposal/design/tasks.

coverage.note: Upgraded: C05 is a software-development architecture spec (plan-builder-like), an extension of the PRD's functional description. bodesign maintains the spec, NOT the firmware code. Only the pin-map bridge exists today.

sections.principle: FW is an extension of the PRD (functional description). bodesign does NOT write firmware; it establishes + maintains the SW-development architecture spec inside C05 using plan-builder-like methodology (proposal/design/tasks + IDEF0/GRAFCET for the software), bridged from PRD functional reqs + C03 pin map.
sections.ai_supplement: FW requirements is thin (brief+objectives+tables); AI's software-architect/plan-builder skill supplies the SW-dev architecture depth (modules/interfaces/state-machine/tasks), extending PRD §7. bodesign owns the spec; source code is team-owned.

fill: in-house vs 外包 (EMC / RF / safety)
verify_with: n/a — C06 is itself the verification layer; its inputs are the C03 verify tools

coverage.note: The verify tools' output IS C06 content; assembling a bring-up/test-plan document is not yet built.

sections.ai_supplement: bodesign drafts the verification/test plan + bring-up checklist from PRD + subsystems; actual EVT/DVT outsourced.

key_gaps: C00 PRD: structured PRD document emitter (kidoc 'prd' doc_type) + PRD completeness/consistency verifier.
C06: a test-plan/bring-up document assembler over the verify verdicts.
C01/C02: an interface-constraints document emitter + cross-section consistency check.
Generic: a per-section 'verify existing content' capability (only C03 has real content verification today).
C05 FW: stand up a plan-builder-like SW-dev spec sub-package (functional spec from PRD + pin map from C03); bodesign owns the spec, not the code.

orchestration: bodesign's MCP is a thin orchestrator across a very large professional span; each C0* layer references a specialized external skill (see each section's `skill`) to do its work. bodesign owns the scaffold, the cross-layer contract, and the readiness compass — not every domain's expertise.
extracted_from: Real 01.Rockbox C01–C07 project folder (de-productized: section architecture only, no client content / company names / part numbers).
